title: Future aspirational claim without clear roadmap or interim targets

source.document: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Greenwashing, 2024

explain.en: Aspirational environmental targets must be supported by a concrete transition plan and verifiable interim milestones.

remediation.en: Include published interim targets, verification body validation (e.g. SBTi), and public roadmap link.

tests.input: We will achieve net zero by 2030 across all operations
Committed to net zero by 2030 with published roadmap and interim target of 50% cut by 2026 (SBTi validated)
tests.notes: Verified transition plan with interim target
